Usage: uv lock [OPTIONS]
Options:
      --check
      --check-exists
      --dry-run
      --script <SCRIPT>
Index options:
      --index <INDEX>
      --default-index <DEFAULT_INDEX>
  -i, --index-url <INDEX_URL>
      --extra-index-url <EXTRA_INDEX_URL>
  -f, --find-links <FIND_LINKS>
      --no-index
      --index-strategy <INDEX_STRATEGY>
      --keyring-provider <KEYRING_PROVIDER>
Resolver options:
  -U, --upgrade
  -P, --upgrade-package <UPGRADE_PACKAGE>
      --upgrade-group <UPGRADE_GROUP>
      --resolution <RESOLUTION>
      --prerelease <PRERELEASE>
      --prerelease-package <PRERELEASE_PACKAGE>
      --fork-strategy <FORK_STRATEGY>
      --exclude-newer <EXCLUDE_NEWER>
      --exclude-newer-package <EXCLUDE_NEWER_PACKAGE>
      --no-sources
      --no-sources-package <NO_SOURCES_PACKAGE>
Build options:
  -C, --config-setting <CONFIG_SETTING>
      --config-settings-package <CONFIG_SETTINGS_PACKAGE>
      --no-build-isolation
      --no-build-isolation-package <NO_BUILD_ISOLATION_PACKAGE>
      --no-build
      --no-build-package <NO_BUILD_PACKAGE>
      --no-binary
      --no-binary-package <NO_BINARY_PACKAGE>
      --require-build-hashes
      --no-require-build-hashes
Installer options:
      --link-mode <LINK_MODE>
Cache options:
  -n, --no-cache
      --cache-dir <CACHE_DIR>
      --refresh
      --refresh-package <REFRESH_PACKAGE>
Python options:
  -p, --python <PYTHON>
      --managed-python
      --no-managed-python
      --no-python-downloads
Global options:
  -q, --quiet...
  -v, --verbose...
      --color <COLOR_CHOICE>
      --system-certs
      --offline
      --allow-insecure-host <ALLOW_INSECURE_HOST>
      --no-progress
      --directory <DIRECTORY>
      --project <PROJECT>
      --config-file <CONFIG_FILE>
      --no-config
  -h, --help
